claim: Wrong-tool selection remains the largest residual failure for every model.

claim: NTEP-R makes every wasted call individually unprofitable while keeping genuinely needed retries profitable.

claim: The reward-optimal policy answers immediately after its last goal completes because every further call earns no credit and strictly lowers the trajectory reward.
